```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                       fig.align = "center", fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4)

if (!exists("project_folder")) {
  project_folder <- getwd()
  pipeline_folder <- getwd()
  features_file <- "config/features.yaml"
  sample_file <- "config/samples.tsv"
}

source(file.path(pipeline_folder, "workflow", "scripts", "R", "report_helpers.R"))
coverm_dir <- file.path(project_folder, "results", "quantify", "coverm")
```

# Genome-level abundance (CoverM)

```{r coverm-genome-summary, results='asis'}
genome_files <- Sys.glob(file.path(coverm_dir, "genome.*.tsv"))
if (length(genome_files) == 0) {
  cat("_No genome-level CoverM output found yet._\n")
}
for (f in genome_files) {
  method <- sub("^genome\\.(.*)\\.tsv$", "\\1", basename(f))
  cat(paste0("\n### Method: ", method, "\n\n"))
  df <- safe_read_tsv(f)
  if (nrow(df) == 0) next
  n_genomes <- nrow(df)
  sample_cols <- setdiff(colnames(df), colnames(df)[1])
  cat(sprintf("**%d** genomes quantified across **%d** libraries.\n\n", n_genomes, length(sample_cols)))
  preview_table(df, n = 15, caption = paste("CoverM genome abundance --", method, "(first 15 genomes)"))
}
```

# Contig-level abundance (CoverM)

```{r coverm-contig-summary, results='asis'}
contig_files <- Sys.glob(file.path(coverm_dir, "contig.*.tsv"))
if (length(contig_files) == 0) {
  cat("_No contig-level CoverM output found yet._\n")
}
for (f in contig_files) {
  method <- sub("^contig\\.(.*)\\.tsv$", "\\1", basename(f))
  cat(paste0("\n### Method: ", method, "\n\n"))
  preview_table(safe_read_tsv(f), n = 15, caption = paste("CoverM contig abundance --", method, "(first 15 contigs)"))
}
```

# Runtime statistics

```{r quantify-runtime}
bench <- discover_benchmarks(project_folder, "quantify")
runtime_table(bench, caption = "quantify module: runtime and peak memory per rule")
```

```{r quantify-resource-allocation}
resource_allocation_table(bench, "quantify", project_folder,

```

